explanation: Indices on the right of `->` are kept; the rest are summed. `ij,jk->ik` sums over `j`: a matmul. `ii->` takes the diagonal and sums it. `i,j->ij` keeps both indices, so nothing is summed: an outer product. The attention string sums over the head dimension `d`, giving query-by-key scores per batch and head. `ij->ji` reorders. `bi,bi->b` multiplies matching rows and sums over `i`. An elementwise product would be `ij,ij->ij`, which is not in the list.
